answer: Sybil clones buy cheap IDs in bulk. Each joiner locks 3.60 POA and is randomly paired for 40 minutes with one licensed verifier on a public dune board. The verifier streams seven 24-byte live challenges; every reply must land within 6 seconds and carry a ripple hash of the prior challenge plus the pair id. Then the verifier must whisper that only one live responder answered — a second key on that channel collides on the pair id and fails. A late link, reused pair, or double-responder report burns 80% of the bond and freezes the key and slot for six epochs.
